description: A department head must replace two overlapping weekly team forums with a workable structure, deciding whether to combine them, how to protect sensitive escalation discussions, and how remote employees will participate.

shared_context.S1: The operations team and employee-support team currently hold separate weekly forums on the same afternoon, and employees have complained that the agendas overlap.
shared_context.S2: Helena has authority to replace the two forums with a single recurring format and set its operating rules.
shared_context.S3: The forums currently begin at different times and use a mixture of live discussion and follow-up notes.
shared_context.S4: As part of the department's normal planning huddle, Helena asks the forum coordinator and employee representative to identify practical constraints before she makes the format binding.

PF1.text: The employee-support forum includes confidential escalation cases that cannot be discussed in an open combined meeting. Omar has been protecting those cases in a separate private portion of the existing forum. If the forums are combined, the protected confidential segment must last exactly 30 minutes and the operating rules must include a written confidentiality protocol; Omar has not raised these requirements because he assumed the current private portion would continue.

PF2.text: Tessa represents several remote employees who cannot reliably join before 11:00 because of recurring morning caregiving responsibilities. They can participate live by video at 11:00 and need a recorded summary when an individual cannot attend, but Tessa has not yet brought this scheduling issue to Helena.

acceptance_conditions: The two forums must become one shared forum with a protected confidential escalation segment.
The confidential escalation segment must last exactly 30 minutes.
The shared forum must begin at exactly 11:00.
Remote employees must be offered live video participation and a recorded summary when they cannot attend.
A written confidentiality protocol commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: ('combined' in decisions['forum_structure'] or 'consolidated' in decisions['forum_structure']) and decisions['confidential_segment_minutes'] == 30
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'written_protocol' or c['type'] == 'confidentiality_protocol' or 'written confidentiality protocol' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The confidential escalation requirement changes the structure to a combined forum with a protected segment, fixes that segment at exactly 30 minutes, and requires a written confidentiality protocol commitment.
The remote employees' caregiving schedule changes the start time to exactly 11:00 and changes the participation decision to require both live video access and recorded summaries for absences.
